paper.title: Study of the Two-Dimensional Frustrated J1-J2 Model with Neural Network Quantum States
paper.authors: Kenny Choo, Titus Neupert, Giuseppe Carleo

results.system_description: 10x10 square lattice, periodic; J1 = 1, J2 = 0.5; S = sigma/2; total Sz = 0
results.source_location: Table I, p. 6 (10 × 10, J2 = 0.5, row CNN)
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of an explicitly represented CNN wavefunction; the table also lists VMC and DMRG comparison values, which are excluded.
results.notes: Also tabulated in arXiv:2005.14142v6 Table II and arXiv:2310.05715v2 Table 1. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
